package: Autonomous-wildfire AI: Alaska as proving ground vs. value capture

verified.story_title: DFFP infrared drone drove 100% containment of the Mastadon Fire near Talkeetna

verified_facts.infrared_drone_flight: An infrared drone flight conducted at 9:30 AM on Friday June 5 detected one area of heat within the fire interior (DFFP).
verified_facts.drone_ordered: Incident Commander ordered an infrared drone for Friday morning to search for hidden hotspots.
verified_facts.containment: Mastadon Fire (#131) declared 100% contained at 1:11 PM Friday June 5, 2026.
verified_facts.ignition: Fire ignited southeast of Talkeetna on June 3, 2026.
verified_facts.agency: Alaska Division of Forestry & Fire Protection (DFFP) UAS Module

verified.notes: Single primary publisher (DFFP). Qualifies as primary source. Independent secondaries 404'd at fetch.

verified.story_title: XPRIZE $11M autonomous-wildfire finals come to Alaska in summer 2026; UAF ACUASI is the testing partner

verified_facts.finalists: Anduril (USA), Data Blanket (USA), Dryad (Germany), FireSwarm Solutions (Canada), Wildfire Quest (USA)
verified_facts.rule: Teams must autonomously detect and suppress a high-risk fire within 10 minutes.
verified_facts.testing_partner: Alaska Center for Unmanned Aircraft Systems Integration (ACUASI), Geophysical Institute, University of Alaska Fairbanks.
verified_facts.location_timing: Final testing round in Alaska in summer 2026.

verified.story_title: HB 217, the autonomous-vehicle human-operator bill, stalled in Senate Rules when the regular session ended May 20

verified_facts.subject: An Act regulating autonomous vehicles (and commercial motor vehicle licensing examinations).
verified_facts.human_operator: Requires an autonomous vehicle operated in this state to have a human safety operator physically present in the vehicle, able to monitor and intervene.
verified_facts.status: Referred to Senate Rules May 17; no Senate floor vote; regular session ended May 20, 2026.
verified_facts.HEDGE: Do NOT say 'died.' A special session began May 21 (scope unconfirmed). Use 'stalled in Senate Rules when the regular session ended May 20' / 'never got a Senate floor vote.'
